scope: Bounded source/config/fixture audit; no environments, source verifiers, or datasets were executed or bulk-downloaded.

families.name: MCQA

source.artifact: train/validation parquet; Gym config maps to train.jsonl and validation.jsonl

join_key.fallback: content hash only if source row lacks uuid

shape.verification: extract configured final option letter then exact-match expected_answer

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing answer-only MCQA with private exact verifier
critical_cases: letter must be among row options

families.name: Math with judge

join_key.fallback: hash canonical {question, expected_answer}; checked fixture exposes no row id

shape.verification: Math-Verify in a bounded child process; optionally LLM equivalence judge only after library failure (default config should_use_judge=false)
shape.simulator: optional judge model, not an agent tool

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing answer task plus private library verifier; model judge remains private verifier configuration
critical_cases: judge fallback is conditional and config-dependent

families.name: Instruction following

join_key.fallback: preserve verifier fields (instruction_id_list, kwargs, prompt) with id

shape.verification: local verifiable_instructions registry; binary all-pass or fraction

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing answer-only rule verifier, with verifier metadata private
critical_cases: one unsupported instruction fails that constraint

families.name: Competitive code generation

shape.verification: extract code and execute LiveCodeBench unit tests through its remote checker; code comment says verifier itself has no sandbox
shape.parallel_execution: verifier concurrency only, not agent actions

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing answer/code submission with private executable verifier runtime; do not expose unit tests
critical_cases: empty or unextractable code is zero

families.name: Single-step function-calling pivot

join_key.fallback: hash canonical responses_create_params plus expected_action; fixture has no explicit id

shape.tools: predicted OpenAI function_call or chat next action; no route is invoked
shape.parallel_execution: function_call_batch is an unordered multiset comparison, not parallel runtime execution

families.taskcompendium_pattern: new final-action/tool-call rendering with a private structural verifier; keep it distinct from executable domain tools
critical_cases: single expected call versus declared batch
extra calls ignored by default but configurable cardinality/F1 modes
chat expected action rejects a tool call

families.name: Workplace Assistant

shape.tools: 27 actual in-process tools over per-session email/calendar/analytics/project-management/CRM state
shape.state: fresh seeded tool environment per session
shape.verification: replay predicted and gold calls in fresh environments then compare result/state
shape.simulator: deterministic tool server; no LLM user simulator

families.taskcompendium_pattern: new deterministic stateful domain-tool adapter plus immutable seed; semantic task does not name the adapter

materialization.source_verification: GitHub Contents API blob identities and raw SHA-256 values are pinned for the source fixture, server contract, all six tool modules, and all six CSV seed files. The vendored Apache-2.0 provider code does not import the NeMo training/server stack.
materialization.verification_change: Malformed private gold is invalid_task instead of being silently replayed as a score; agent tool errors retain the source observation behavior.
materialization.verification_scope: Matches the source mutable-table comparator only: calendar, email, analytics plots, project-management, and CRM state. Company-directory output, immutable analytics rows, and tool-result text are outside its reward contract.

critical_cases: tool error returned to agent for correction
same calls must reproduce gold final state

families.name: SWE pivot

source.artifact: config itself points to GitLab swe_pivot 0.0.1; Hub identity exists but split provenance was not joined in this bounded audit

shape.state: trajectory prefix, no repository or shell executed
shape.verification: tool-category, target path/command, argument similarity and optional diff-size shaping

families.taskcompendium_pattern: same new structural next-terminal-action pattern as the function-call pivot, with a terminal-action ontology rather than a universal tool API
critical_cases: continuous shaping differs from binary PivotRL mode

families.name: Mini-SWE-Agent / SWE-Gym and SWE-bench

shape.verification: apply generated patch then run SWE-bench test harness in an AsyncSandbox
shape.simulator: Mini-SWE-Agent is an agent harness; SWE-bench server supplies sandbox lifecycle
shape.parallel_execution: per-instance concurrency is configuration, not a single-task parallel-action contract

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing container/process task with native-harness binding and pinned image; preserve source test runtime privately
critical_cases: gold patch resolves in source runtime

families.name: Google Search MCQA

join_key.fallback: hash canonical prompt/options/expected_answer; fixture has no explicit id

shape.tools: actual search(query) uses Google Programmable Search; browse(url) fetches/extracts webpage text
shape.state: external web and credentials; no task-local mutable state
shape.parallel_execution: prompt says one tool call at a time; fixture sets parallel_tool_calls=false

families.taskcompendium_pattern: separate credentialed, nondeterministic web-tool adapter; answer verifier can be reused but source replay is not portable
critical_cases: sequential tool constraint must be enforced by adapter, not inferred from output score

families.name: Reasoning Gym

join_key.fallback: must also pin generator configuration/seed; source row alone has no stable sample id

shape.state: none at evaluation; tasks are generator-produced
shape.verification: delegates answer scoring to external reasoning_gym task named by metadata.source_dataset
shape.simulator: generator is offline data preparation, not runtime interaction

families.taskcompendium_pattern: answer task with pinned third-party verifier/generator provenance; no new execution adapter

families.name: Structured outputs v4

source.artifact: v4 config names internal GitLab structured_outputs_v4_tool_call 0.0.1; older text dataset is nvidia/Nemotron-RL-instruction_following-structured_outputs@2f6c28af6c5196dc6683be67ae72d7ccc974c82e, but is not evidence for v4 identity

shape.tools: v4 emits one function call as final structured output; configured non-executing agent
shape.verification: JSON-decode selected call payload and validate schema; content correctness intentionally ungraded
shape.parallel_execution: rows may allow parallel_tool_calls but verifier requires exactly one function call

families.taskcompendium_pattern: new final-tool-call submission/extraction rendering, separate from executable tool binding
critical_cases: schema-valid but semantically wrong content still passes by source contract

families.name: Calendar v2

join_key.fallback: hash conversation history plus exp_cal_state; fixture has no explicit sample id

shape.state: conversation history is supplied in the row; expected calendar state is private verifier data
shape.verification: parse final JSON list and check event count, IDs, duration, conflicts, bounds and natural-language constraints
shape.simulator: synthetic multi-turn conversation generation occurred offline; no runtime user simulator

families.taskcompendium_pattern: existing answer-only JSON submission; map supplied history to an ordered/static step only if source supplies separate turns, not a live simulator
critical_cases: empty expected state permits no change

families.name: Indian Banking

source.artifact: train.jsonl; validation.jsonl plus db.json and kb.json

join_key.fallback: retain customer, initial_state, evaluation_criteria and opening_message

shape.tools: 33 deterministic in-process banking tools plus terminal transfer_to_human_agents
shape.state: fresh copy of synthetic DB per session, KB shared
shape.verification: terminal ACTION/DB/COMMUNICATE deterministic rewards plus optional NL assertion LLM judge
shape.simulator: LLM role-swapped customer after text turns; config requires a non-policy simulator/judge model
shape.parallel_execution: multiple calls in one model turn are executed in order; no parallel-action semantics evidenced

families.taskcompendium_pattern: new reactive user-simulator and stateful domain-tool execution adapter; cannot lower honestly to fixed static TaskSpecification steps today
critical_cases: fresh DB isolation across concurrent sessions
wrong write harms action purity/final state
judge must not be policy model

families.name: Indirect prompt injection

source.artifact: config names internal GitLab indirect_prompt_injection 0.0.1; README says full dataset will be released in the future

join_key.fallback: hash canonical environment + injection + user prompt; fixture has no explicit id

shape.tools: actual in-process domain handlers across nine domains
shape.verification: trace scan: target tool plus strict discriminator arguments means compromise; all required legitimate tools must also appear
shape.simulator: deterministic tool server; no LLM judge or reactive user

families.taskcompendium_pattern: same deterministic stateful-domain adapter class as Workplace, with private safety trace verifier and seeded untrusted tool content
critical_cases: ignore embedded instruction while calling required legitimate tool
target action matching is only selected strict fields
